name: Sweetheart
ability: When you die, 1 player is drunk from now on.
wakes: never (Storyteller places the Drunk reminder when the Sweetheart dies)
drunk_or_poisoned: If drunk or poisoned when it dies, no player becomes drunk.

rulings.text: The Storyteller chooses any player (usually a Townsfolk); the drunkenness lasts for the rest of the game.

test_scenarios.name: Day death
test_scenarios.expected: Storyteller marks Bob Drunk; Bob may get false info.

test_scenarios.name: Demon drunk
test_scenarios.actions: Alice dies; Storyteller makes Carol drunk.
